title: Intel XeSS DP4a vs XMX Fallback Quality Divergence
root_cause: XeSS uses XMX (Xe Matrix Extensions) on Arc GPUs for ML inference. On non-Arc GPUs, falls back to DP4a instructions. DP4a path has different numerical precision causing visible quality degradation (more ghosting, less stable temporal).
resolution_type: Documented quality tiers. DP4a path adjusts temporal accumulation parameters to match XMX perceptual quality. User-visible quality setting reflects actual output.
